Label the three rectangles, from left to right, \(L,M,R\).

- The top triangular base is attached to rectangle \(L\). Its vertex \(P\) is opposite that attached side, so when folded, \(P\) becomes the top vertex where the other two faces \(M\) and \(R\) meet.
- The common vertical edge between rectangles \(M\) and \(R\) is therefore the lateral edge containing \(P\).
- Looking at the bottom of that same common edge in the net, the endpoint is labeled \(R\).

\[
\boxed{\text{Point }R\quad\text{(Choice B)}}
\]
